ordered_branches.explanation: Normalizes empty warehouse string toNULL. INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS lookup is by table and column only, without schema; duplicate rows assign unordered and absent second lookup can retain prior data type. Select expression is COUNT(*) special case, SUM for data type exactly numeric, otherwise COUNT(column); other numeric types therefore count values. Grouping data type exactly datetime uses float-floor datetime conversion to day; other types grouped unchanged. Fixed privately inspected query uses inclusive BETWEEN date endpoints; values are parameterized, while table/group/select/date-column syntax is concatenated without identifier quoting/allowlist. Declared nvarchar50 @SELECT_COLUMN can truncate expanded expression. No final ORDER BY. With no warehouse filter, equality-to-self still excludes NULL warehouse (or both NULL from/to fields).

limitations: This is the retained 2026-09-29 replica capture, not a new database inspection. Static references do not establish branch execution, current use or runtime table scans. Vendor-base versus customer customization ownership is not established by names or comments.
A captured source reference establishes a static relationship, not that a module ran, a branch was reached, or a table is currently active.

NO_CAPTURED_REFERENCE means none of the credited channels in this exact retained corpus identified the table. It does not establish that the table is unused, obsolete, a backup, safe to delete, or absent from external application SQL.
